sentences.en: The clock that got broken must be repaired right away.
sentences.zh: 这个坏了的钟必须马上修理。

sentences.en: Uncle Bob fixed my clock. It keeps good time now.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃叔叔修好了我的钟。现在走得很准。

sentences.en: The quality of craftsmanship in this clock company is unsurpassed.
sentences.zh: 这家制钟公司的工艺水平无与伦比。
